subject: Passkey enrollment blocks PO visibility — Cerulean Labs onboarding
messages:
From: Alex Stone <alex.stone@ceruleanlabs.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Cerulean Labs Procurement <procurement@ceruleanlabs.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Passkey enrollment page blocks PO visibility during vendor setup

Hi Ethan / Ben,

We started vendor onboarding this morning and hit a blocker: when our finance user tries to complete the Cerulean vendor form and enroll a passkey, the portal shows the passkey enrollment modal and then the subsequent page (where bank details and PO visibility appear) never loads — it sits on a blank frame and the PO / account lines remain hidden. We've attached a screenshot of the blank frame and the PDF we attempted to upload (cerulean_vendor_form.pdf).

Steps we did:
- Click invite link from Redwood portal email
- Follow SSO prompt (Okta) -> redirect to onboarding flow
- Passkey prompt appears to register device
- After consenting, the page frame remains blank and PO line items are not visible in the vendor profile

This is blocking our first PO for this supplier today. Can you advise a short-term bypass? We can try a different enrollment method if you suggest one.

Thanks,
Alex Stone
Head of Procurement
Cerulean Labs
alex.stone@ceruleanlabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: cerulean_vendor_form.pdf, screenshot-passkey-error.png

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Stone <alex.stone@ceruleanlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Passkey enrollment page blocks PO visibility during vendor setup

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear steps and attachments. Sorry you're blocked; we'll prioritize.

Short-term workaround: could your finance user try the "Use existing credentials" link on the enroll screen? That will fallback to a password-based flow while we investigate passkey enrollment. If that link is not present for you, reply and we can send a one-time legacy access link to complete the vendor profile (expires in 24 hours).

We're already opening a ticket with infra to look at the passkey/iframe interaction. Ben — can you pull the onboarding flow logs for the Cerulean tenant (time window 2026-07-18T16:45:00Z to 2026-07-18T17:05:00Z) and check for any blocked third-party storage or cookie policy that could cause the iframe to render blank? Also cc Laura to track procurement ops comms.

Alex — once you confirm whether the fallback works, we'll coordinate to finish bank details and confirm PO visibility.

Cheers,
Ethan Park
Senior Ops Manager, Onboarding
Redwood Inference
ethan_park@redwood.com

Attachments: (none)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Passkey enrollment page blocks PO visibility during vendor setup

Ethan / Laura — quick triage notes from the onboarding runtime:

- I reproduced a blank iframe in a local session when a passkey registration POST responded with 204 and the client attempted to access the parent session cookie; the browser (Chrome 103+) prevented access due to SameSite/Lax+frame-src combination in our CSP.
- Suspect root cause: new passkey script sets a transient credential in a top-level storage area; our iframe relies on that cookie to flip the UI from "enrolled" -> "profile complete". If the cookie is partitioned or blocked, the renderer never toggles.
- SUP-4123 created and linked (related_links). I've attached the screenshot you provided for reference.

Short-term mitigations:
1) Ask Cerulean to use the legacy credentials fallback as Ethan suggested (fastest).
2) We can push a targeted toggle to disable the passkey enforcement for the Cerulean tenant for 48 hours while they finish onboarding — requires ops signoff and a short config change.

Operational impact: disabling for a single tenant only affects new enrollments and retains normal passkey behavior for others. If we do the config toggle, we should notify Cerulean to re-enroll a passkey after onboarding.

I'll prepare the ops change; Ethan, want me to proceed with the temporary toggle and an audit log entry?

Ben Carter
Platform Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: screenshot-passkey-error.png

From: Alex Stone <alex.stone@ceruleanlabs.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Cerulean IT <it-support@ceruleanlabs.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Passkey enrollment page blocks PO visibility during vendor setup

Thanks Ethan / Ben — quick update from our side: we tried the "Use existing credentials" fallback link and it worked (our finance user completed the vendor form and the bank details / PO lines are now visible). That unblocked the PO processing for Cerulean Purchase Order #CL-2026-112.

If you proceed with the temporary toggle, please coordinate timing — we'll re-enroll a passkey later this week and can validate post-change. Appreciate the speedy help.

Alex Stone
Head of Procurement
Cerulean Labs
